authority_basis.summary: Continue the sharp flavor program from the exact orbit-3 obstruction.

operations.title: The invariant flavor structure carried by a sparse support is its semialgebraic positive-Gram image and discriminant walls, not its chart loop phase; viability selects supports whose Gram cones contain the physical point.
Orbit 3 has the exact realizability wall C(AB-p)=rA+qB+2 sqrt(pqr), with the allowed chamber on the greater-than-or-equal side.
Symbolic convexity, unique minimizer, closed minimum, and six-label physical audit.
